incident.title: An incident inside a restricted pool
incident.brief: This service cannot move regulated traffic to the alternate pool. Leave overflow off. The primary retains reduced capacity. Keep 96% of voice turns within deadline and finish at least 36% of batch jobs. It is acceptable to temporarily reject batch jobs during the fault.

model.reason: The plan prioritizes voice traffic and preserves batch capacity by allocating 50% of primary capacity to voice and admitting no new batch requests during the fault.

failures: Restricted traffic cannot leave the primary pool

revision.reason: Increase reserve_pct to prioritize voice traffic and reduce batch admission to prevent batch completion floor from being missed during slow recovery.
